name: Entegris
description: Entegris sells the ultra-pure materials and contamination-control products that chip fabs consume while making chips. One segment, Materials Solutions, sells deposition precursors, CMP slurries and pads, implant gases and etch and clean chemistries. The other, Advanced Purity Solutions, sells filters, purifiers, chemical containers and wafer carriers (FOUPs) that keep liquids, gases and wafers clean. Customers are logic and memory chipmakers and equipment makers, with TSMC alone about 16% of 2025 sales and the top ten about 50%; 82% of sales are outside the US. Revenue tracks wafer production and the number of process steps and new materials per chip, so it moves with the chip cycle, and the company carries $3.7 billion of debt (principal outstanding at December 31, 2025), which cost $199.8M of interest expense in 2025.

businessLines.name: Advanced Purity Solutions (APS)
businessLines.how: Sells filters, purifiers, carriers and containers to fabs and the wider chip ecosystem through a direct sales force and distributors; products wear out or are consumed with each fab's chemical and gas flows, so sales follow wafer volumes and new fab builds.
businessLines.description: Filtration, purification and contamination-control: liquid and gas filters and purifiers, wafer and reticle transport (FOUPs, SMIF and EUV pods), ultra-pure chemical containers, valves, fittings and fluid monitoring.

operatingProfit.note: Segment profit before amortization of intangibles and unallocated G&A; FY2024 $496.1M; FY2023 $531.4M; Q2 2026 $150.9M vs $95.9M

businessLines.name: Materials Solutions (MS)
businessLines.how: Sells process materials that are used up in each wafer step (deposition films, polishing slurries and pads, implant gases, etch and clean chemicals); more process steps and new materials such as molybdenum raise the dollar content per wafer.
businessLines.description: Chemical vapor and atomic layer deposition precursors, CMP slurries and pads, ion implant specialty gases, formulated etch and clean materials, selective etch chemistries and other specialty materials.
